visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A fluffy Corgi dog is seated centrally in a brightly lit studio with purple and pink pastel tones. The dog is heavily accessorized with a curly brown wig, pink heart-shaped sunglasses, white bunny ears, and a white shirt featuring a red bow. It looks directly at the camera with its mouth open. (2) The scene transitions through several rapid costume changes. The dog appears in a blonde wig with bunny ears, a blue mohawk with yellow star glasses while holding a toy guitar, and a black bob wig with a mustache. A hand is briefly seen adjusting a purple feather boa around the dog's neck. (3) A digital photo booth screen displays three 'selfie' frames of the dog in different costumes. A human hand uses a stylus to tap the 'Print' button on the touchscreen. A white printer machine then ejects a glossy photo strip containing the captured images of the Corgi in its various wigs.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic, high-pitched electronic pop track featuring bright synth leads and a steady four-on-the-floor beat. A female narrator speaks excitedly in Korean, her voice characterized by high pitch and enthusiastic rising intonations. (2) A sharp, crisp camera shutter 'click' sound effect triggers during a costume change. The background music remains continuous and upbeat. The narrator continues her animated commentary, synchronized with the rapid visual cuts and flashing lights. (3) A distinct mechanical whirring sound of a printer motor is heard as the photo strip emerges. This is punctuated by a final bubbly UI sound effect and a cheerful concluding phrase from the female speaker, maintaining high energy until the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain viewers by showcasing a Corgi in various humorous costumes within a themed photo booth, highlighting the cute results and the interactive 'selfie' process.
